top_signals.title: South Korea Keeps Fuel Cheap for Holidays as Fiscal Cost Mounts
top_signals.summary: With millions of South Koreans set to hit the road this week during a three-day public holiday, the government is extending fuel-price caps, cushioning households from an energy shock that has pushed global oil prices above $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Apollo Caps Private Credit Fund Again After 14.7% Look to Exit
top_signals.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is limiting redemptions from a private credit fund for the third straight quarter, as its investors join the rush to pull cash from the $1.8 trillion direct lending market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
top_signals.summary: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
